analysis.summary: Accent Microcell reported a 31.92% increase in revenue from operations for FY26, reaching ₹34,903.28 Lakhs. The company is currently expanding its total installed capacity from 9,200 MTPA to 12,000 MTPA through the development of Unit-III, which will focus on high-margin specialty excipients. Management noted that the implementation of this new facility has been delayed by abnormal monsoon seasons and regulatory approval processes. Despite these headwinds, the company maintains a strong export presence, which accounts for over 63% of its total revenue.

guidance.claim: Unit-III is projected to generate ₹70 crore in revenue during its first year of operation.
The revenue mix for Unit-III is expected to be 60% from exports and 40% from domestic sales.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports account for 63.28% of the company's total revenue.
demand_outlook.quote: 22,086.80 Lakhs (63.28%) of the Company’s Revenue comes from exports.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic markets contribute 36.72% to the company's total revenue.
demand_outlook.quote: 12,816.48 Lakhs (36.72%) of the Company’s Revenue comes from domestic markets.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 18.18% for the 2026 fiscal year.
The PAT margin for FY26 was 12.57%.
EBITDA grew by 31.34% year-on-year to reach 6,345.83 Lakhs.

orders_capacity.claim: The Pirana manufacturing unit is operating at 100% capacity utilization.
The Dahej SEZ unit is operating at 95% capacity utilization.
The Dahej SEZ unit has an installed capacity of 7,200 MTPA.
The Pirana unit has an installed capacity of 2,000 MTPA.

capital_allocation.claim: Reserves and surplus increased to 25,149.56 Lakhs as of March 31, 2026.
